messages:
Sam (Sales): quick handover — transferring Orbit Edge to CS. Contract signed yesterday. 10 seats, private deployment (VPC), Okta SSO, EU data residency required. Start onboarding target: 2026-05-04. Renewal window ~11 months out. Main product ask from POC: low-latency reranking for search. @Jordan you are primary CSM. Contract link: https://redwood.example/contracts/ORB-203 (internal only)

Jordan (CSM): thanks Sam — noted. Can you confirm Okta admin contact and whether customer needs a pre-provisioned IdP? Also is there a preferred kickoff time (their PM asked for week of 5/4). Quick heads-up: procurement flagged budget approval cycles — potential renewal risk if usage doesn't show value by month 9.

Nora (Account Exec): FYI we added a 30% usage credit in the contract for month 1 to help adoption. Procurement contact: helen@orbidedge.com. No special licensing terms beyond what Sam sent.

Melissa (CS Ops): copying checklist/owners — we should map this out now: 
- CSM: Jordan — overall owner, kickoff, success plan
- Enablement owner: Melissa — API + console walkthrough + runbook
- Eng support owner: Arun — infra prep, VPC peering, KMS
- Feedback capture: Jordan + Melissa (post-demo survey + weekly usage check)
- Renewal monitor: Nora (procurement touchpoints)
Please add JIRA/triage owners for infra tasks.

Arun (Eng Support): tech notes: private deploy path needs: VPC peering, route tables, customer NAT config, and KMS key ARN. Estimate prep + staging deploy ~3 business days once networking is approved. We'll need a support ticket with customer CID and VPC CIDR. Also note: if they want low-latency reranking we'll propose a dedicated pool config (dedicated instances, continuous batching off during demos).

Jordan (CSM): proposed next steps + owners + dates: 
- 5/01: Pre-kickoff checklist completed (Melissa)
- 5/04: Kickoff call (Jordan lead, Sam + Nora + Orbit PM + Arun)
- 5/06: Staging VPC ready & smoke test (Arun)
- 5/11: Enablement session + API keys + product walkthrough (Melissa)
- Ongoing: Weekly adoption check-ins weeks 2–8 (Jordan)
Assigning follow-ups: Melissa pls create enablement invite and slides. Arun pls open infra ticket referencing CID ORB-203-VPC. Nora pls confirm procurement milestones and budget approver list.

Melissa (CS Ops): I'll schedule enablement and create a short one-pager runbook for their SREs. Suggest we prepare a 5–7 prompt eval set for reranking signals so we can monitor quality and flag regressions early. I'll attach that to the kickoff materials.

Arun (Eng Support): opened support ticket #SUP-6129 with initial checklist. Need Okta admin (email) + customer CID + VPC CIDR. Also pinging redwood-deploy-bot for planned staging deploy window.

redwood-deploy-bot: Planned staging deploy window requested: 2026-05-03 02:00-06:00 UTC. Reply with :confirm to lock.

Jordan (CSM): owners confirmed. Action items: 
- Sam: please confirm Okta admin (Helen) and share contact on thread (Sam) — due 1719901260
- Melissa: enablement invite + eval prompts — due 1719901280
- Arun: infra ticket and deploy prep — due 1719901290
- Nora: procurement approver list + timeline — due 1719901296
I'll set kickoff calendar and draft initial success metrics (time-to-first-query < 200ms P95, adoption = 5 active seats interacting week 2).

Sam (Sales): confirmed Okta admin: helen@orbitedge.com. Thanks everyone — Jordan, Melissa, Arun: appreciate the fast turnaround. :thumbsup:

Jordan (CSM): got it. I'll lock the kickoff for 2026-05-04 16:00 CET and share dial-in + pre-read by EOD. Will also add a feedback capture plan: 5-question post-kickoff survey + weekly short pulse for first 6 weeks.

Melissa (CS Ops): added the eval prompts to the kickoff doc and uploaded runbook to the customer folder.

Arun (Eng Support): staging deploy window confirmed, ticket updated with VPC CIDR provided by Sam.

Jordan (CSM): closing the sync here — moving detailed tasks into CS board. If procurement stalls, Nora will escalate to AE. Thanks all.

Sam (Sales): thanks team, leaving this in great hands. :rocket:
